title: Hosted measurement workflow and evidence-return contract
outOfScope: Release workflow, release version/tag changes, provider release/tag operations, PR merge, and branch deletion. The existing release.json is in scope only for its generated candidate supply-chain digest projection.

Existing hosted dispatch, non-release purpose, and artifact behavior.
Existing exact commit, clean candidate, and receipt binding boundary.

rawUserRequest: Execute the complete remediation plan automatically; record authorization in every Work Item Contract. Use governed corrective work, no temporary repair, and preserve Outcome traffic-light visibility.

declaredIntent.summary: Make hosted measurement dispatch unambiguous and return reproducible, exact-commit evidence without granting provider-operation authority.

riskAssessment.unknownsReviewReason: Existing workflow and snapshot implementation provide the required evidence surface.

override.reason: Implement governed hosted measurement only; no provider operation.
notRunChecks: No live hosted dispatch is performed during implementation; hosted workflow behavior is verified by local workflow/receipt regressions and later PR CI.

preReviewWarnings: Review that dispatch never authorizes PR, merge, release, archive, or branch deletion.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Bind implementation and final hosted-evidence semantics.

acceptance: The template provides a hosted-measurement workflow path with explicit branch/ref, dispatch purpose, and non-release semantics.
The returned receipt contract records run URL, workflow/run identity, exact commit binding, required jobs, conclusions, artifacts, and a Summary write-back shape.
Documentation states that a hosted receipt is evidence only and never authorizes PR, merge, archive, release, or branch deletion.
Focused regressions prove dispatch/receipt semantics and fail closed on missing or mismatched exact-commit evidence.
guidelines: Public commands and receipt schemas are documented with their authority boundary.
Workflow changes use immutable action references and preserve fail-closed verification.

intent.problem: Hosted measurement was documented but lacked a complete workflow/evidence-return contract, so users could confuse a push or dispatch with a release-authorized action. The added pinned artifact action changes the committed SBOM and requires the existing candidate supply-chain projection to be refreshed atomically.
constraints: Do not make snapshot preparation stage, commit, push, merge, archive, release, or delete.
Do not weaken exact commit, clean-tree, or required-job validation.
Do not change release workflow behavior or release version/tag facts.
Refresh only the generated candidate supply-chain evidence chain required to bind the changed SBOM.
intent.rationale: A standardized receipt makes hosted measurement reproducible while retaining human control of provider operations. Refreshing the entire dependent evidence chain prevents contradictory candidate metadata.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized automatic execution and Contract recording for every planned Work Item; this approval is limited to the #618 smoke workflow receipt contract, its tests/docs, and the dependent generated candidate supply-chain evidence refresh.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and retain archived receipt evidence.
